<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Happy Birthday, Stevanus</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cormorant+Garamond:ital,wght@0,400;0,500;0,600;1,500&family=Marcellus&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  :root{
    --obsidian:#04060e;
    --wine:#12203f;
    --gold:#c9a15e;
    --gold-bright:#f0cf8e;
    --rose:#8fa2d8;
    --cream:#f4e9d8;
    --cream-dim:#c9bda8;
    --line: rgba(201,161,94,0.35);
  }
  *{box-sizing:border-box;}
  html,body{margin:0;padding:0;}
  body{
    background:
      radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% -10%, #12203f 0%, transparent 60%),
      radial-gradient(ellipse at 10% 110%, #0c1630 0%, transparent 55%),
      var(--obsidian);
    color:var(--cream);
    font-family:'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
    min-height:100vh;
    overflow-x:hidden;
    -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
  }
  .utility{font-family:'Marcellus', serif; letter-spacing:0.28em; text-transform:uppercase; font-size:11px; color:var(--gold);}

  /* ambient floating embers */
  #embers{position:fixed; inset:0; pointer-events:none; z-index:1;}
  .ember{
    position:absolute; bottom:-10px; width:3px; height:3px; border-radius:50%;
    background:var(--gold-bright); opacity:0.7; filter:blur(0.3px);
    animation:rise linear infinite;
  }
  @keyframes rise{
    0%{transform:translateY(0) translateX(0); opacity:0;}
    10%{opacity:0.8;}
    100%{transform:translateY(-110vh) translateX(var(--drift)); opacity:0;}
  }

  .stage{
    position:relative; z-index:2;
    min-height:100vh; width:100%;
    display:none;
    align-items:center; justify-content:center;
    flex-direction:column;
    padding:40px 20px;
    text-align:center;
  }
  .stage.active{display:flex; animation:fadein 1.1s ease both;}
  @keyframes fadein{from{opacity:0; transform:translateY(14px);} to{opacity:1; transform:translateY(0);}}

  .flourish{width:120px; height:auto; margin:0 auto 22px; opacity:0.85;}
  .flourish.flip{transform:scaleY(-1); margin:22px auto 0;}

  h1,h2{font-weight:500; margin:0; color:var(--gold-bright);}
  .display{
    font-size:clamp(34px, 6vw, 62px);
    font-style:italic;
    line-height:1.15;
  }
  .step-title{font-size:clamp(26px,4.5vw,38px);}
  .sub{
    font-family:'Marcellus', serif;
    color:var(--cream-dim);
    font-size:15px;
    letter-spacing:0.05em;
    max-width:480px;
    margin:16px auto 0;
    line-height:1.7;
  }

  .monogram{
    font-family:'Marcellus', serif; letter-spacing:0.34em;
    font-size:13px; color:var(--gold); margin-bottom:6px; text-transform:uppercase;
  }
  .monogram .amp{color:var(--gold-bright); opacity:.6; margin:0 4px;}

  .btn{
    margin-top:34px;
    background:transparent;
    border:1px solid var(--gold);
    color:var(--gold-bright);
    font-family:'Marcellus', serif;
    letter-spacing:0.22em;
    text-transform:uppercase;
    font-size:12px;
    padding:16px 36px;
    cursor:pointer;
    position:relative;
    transition:all .5s ease;
  }
  .btn:hover{background:var(--gold); color:#06101f; box-shadow:0 0 28px rgba(240,207,142,0.45);}
  .btn:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--gold-bright); outline-offset:4px;}
  .more-hint{font-family:'Marcellus',serif; font-size:10px; letter-spacing:.22em;
    text-transform:uppercase; color:rgba(201,189,168,.5); margin:16px 0 0;}
  .btn.quiet{border-color:rgba(201,161,94,.45); color:var(--cream-dim); margin-top:16px;}

  /* candle scene */
  .candles{display:flex; gap:26px; margin:36px 0 8px; flex-wrap:wrap; justify-content:center;}
  .candle{cursor:pointer; -webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent;}
  .candle svg{width:34px; height:110px; display:block;}
  .flame{transform-origin:50% 100%; animation:flicker 1.6s ease-in-out infinite;}
  @keyframes flicker{
    0%,100%{transform:scale(1) rotate(-1deg);}
    50%{transform:scale(1.08,0.94) rotate(2deg);}
  }
  .candle.out .flame{display:none;}
  .candle.out .smoke{opacity:1;}
  .smoke{opacity:0; transition:opacity .3s; animation:smokeUp 2.5s ease-out infinite;}
  @keyframes smokeUp{0%{transform:translateY(0) scale(1); opacity:.5;} 100%{transform:translateY(-30px) scale(1.6); opacity:0;}}
  .candle-hint{font-size:13px; color:var(--cream-dim); margin-top:6px; font-family:'Marcellus',serif; letter-spacing:.08em;}

  /* puzzle */
  #puzzle-board{
    width:min(78vw, 340px); height:min(78vw, 340px);
    display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr); grid-template-rows:repeat(3,1fr);
    gap:3px; margin:18px auto 6px;
    border:1px solid var(--line); padding:3px;
    background:#000;
  }
  .tile{
    background-color:#0e1730;
    background-size:300% 300%;
    display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
    cursor:pointer;
    transition:transform .25s ease;
    border:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
  }
  .tile:hover{filter:brightness(1.08);}
  .tile.blank{background:transparent; cursor:default; box-shadow:none; border:none;}
  #puzzle-goal-label{font-size:12px; letter-spacing:.15em; color:var(--cream-dim); font-family:'Marcellus',serif; margin-top:2px;}

  /* riddle */
  .riddle-box{max-width:440px;}
  .riddle-q{font-style:italic; font-size:22px; line-height:1.5; margin:18px 0 22px; color:var(--cream);}
  .riddle-input{
    background:transparent; border:none; border-bottom:1px solid var(--gold);
    color:var(--gold-bright); font-family:'Cormorant Garamond', serif; font-style:italic;
    font-size:20px; text-align:center; padding:8px 4px; width:260px; outline:none;
  }
  .riddle-input::placeholder{color:rgba(201,189,168,0.4);}
  .riddle-msg{min-height:22px; font-family:'Marcellus',serif; font-size:12px; letter-spacing:.08em; margin-top:14px; color:var(--rose);}
  .riddle-progress{display:flex; gap:8px; margin-top:26px; justify-content:center;}
  .dot{width:6px; height:6px; border-radius:50%; background:rgba(201,161,94,0.25); transition:background .4s;}
  .dot.done{background:var(--gold-bright); box-shadow:0 0 8px var(--gold-bright);}

  /* seal */
  .seal-wrap{cursor:pointer; user-select:none; margin-top:30px;}
  .seal{
    width:150px; height:150px; border-radius:50%;
    background: radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%, #2b4da5, #0e1f4e 70%);
    display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
    box-shadow:0 0 40px rgba(34,62,150,0.55), inset 0 0 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.6);
    transition:transform .6s cubic-bezier(.6,.1,.3,1.3);
    position:relative;
  }
  .seal::after{
    content:''; position:absolute; inset:10px; border-radius:50%;
    border:1px solid rgba(240,207,142,0.35);
  }
  .seal svg{width:60%; height:60%; opacity:.9;}
  .seal-wrap.cracked .seal{transform:scale(1.15) rotate(8deg); opacity:0;}
  .seal-wrap.cracked{pointer-events:none;}

  /* gallery */
  .collage{column-count:2; column-gap:16px; max-width:520px; margin:28px auto 0;}
  .plate{break-inside:avoid; margin:0 0 16px; position:relative;
    border:1px solid var(--line); padding:8px; background:rgba(8,14,32,.55);
    box-shadow:0 18px 44px rgba(0,0,0,.55);}
  .plate img{width:100%; aspect-ratio:3/4; object-fit:cover; display:block; filter:saturate(.92) contrast(1.03);}
  .plate figcaption{font-family:'Marcellus',serif; font-size:11px; letter-spacing:.16em; text-transform:uppercase;
    color:var(--gold); text-align:center; margin-top:10px;}
  .collage .plate:nth-child(2){margin-top:26px;}
  .collage .plate:nth-child(4){margin-top:12px;}
  @media (max-width:430px){ .collage{column-count:1; max-width:300px;} .collage .plate{margin-top:0 !important;} }

  /* reveal card */
  .card{
    max-width:520px; width:100%; margin:26px auto 0; text-align:left;
    background:linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(16,27,56,0.72), rgba(8,14,32,0.72));
    border:1px solid var(--line); padding:38px 30px 30px; position:relative;
    box-shadow:0 30px 80px rgba(0,0,0,0.6);
  }
  .card::before{content:''; position:absolute; inset:9px; border:1px solid rgba(201,161,94,0.18); pointer-events:none;}
  .stamp{display:inline-block; font-family:'Marcellus',serif; font-size:10px; letter-spacing:.26em;
    text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--gold); border:1px solid var(--line); padding:6px 14px; margin-bottom:18px;}
  .card h3{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif; font-style:italic; font-weight:600;
    font-size:clamp(24px,5vw,32px); color:var(--gold-bright); margin:0 0 20px;}
  .row{display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:baseline; gap:16px;
    padding:11px 0; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(201,161,94,0.16);}
  .row:last-of-type{border-bottom:none;}
  .row .k{font-family:'Marcellus',serif; font-size:10px; letter-spacing:.2em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--gold); white-space:nowrap;}
  .row .v{font-size:18px; color:var(--cream); text-align:right;}
  .note{margin:20px 0 0; padding-top:18px; border-top:1px dashed rgba(201,161,94,0.28);
    font-size:18px; line-height:1.75; font-style:italic; color:var(--cream-dim);}

  .details-photos{display:flex; gap:14px; margin-top:22px; justify-content:center;}
  .details-photo{width:46%; aspect-ratio:3/4; object-fit:cover; border:1px solid var(--line); padding:5px; background:rgba(0,0,0,.4);}

  /* letter */
  #letter-scroll{
    max-width:560px; background:linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(16,27,56,0.60), rgba(8,14,32,0.60));
    border:1px solid var(--line); padding:44px 34px; position:relative;
    box-shadow:0 30px 80px rgba(0,0,0,0.6); margin-top:30px;
  }
  #letter-scroll::before, #letter-scroll::after{
    content:''; position:absolute; left:20px; right:20px; height:1px;
    background:linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, var(--gold), transparent);
  }
  #letter-scroll::before{top:14px;}
  #letter-scroll::after{bottom:14px;}
  .letter-to{font-family:'Marcellus',serif; letter-spacing:.2em; text-transform:uppercase; font-size:12px; color:var(--gold); margin-bottom:18px;}
  .letter-body{font-size:19px; line-height:1.85; color:var(--cream); text-align:left;}
  .letter-sign{margin-top:26px; font-style:italic; font-size:22px; color:var(--gold-bright); text-align:right;}



  /* gift box */
  .gift{cursor:pointer; user-select:none; -webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent; margin:30px 0 0;}
  .gift svg{width:min(64vw,260px); height:auto; display:block; overflow:visible;}
  .gift g{transform-box:fill-box; transform-origin:center;}
  #bow, #lid, #ribbon-v, #rays{transition:transform .55s cubic-bezier(.34,1.4,.5,1), opacity .5s ease;}

  .gift[data-pull="1"] #bow{transform:rotate(-7deg) scale(.93);}
  .gift[data-pull="1"] #lid{transform:translateY(-4px);}
  .gift[data-pull="2"] #bow{transform:translateY(-10px) rotate(13deg) scale(.82); opacity:.45;}
  .gift[data-pull="2"] #lid{transform:translateY(-9px) rotate(-2deg);}
  .gift[data-pull="2"] #ribbon-v{opacity:.5;}

  .gift.opened{pointer-events:none;}
  .gift.opened #bow{transform:translate(30px,-90px) rotate(48deg) scale(.6); opacity:0;}
  .gift.opened #lid{transform:translate(-14px,-96px) rotate(-16deg); opacity:0;}
  .gift.opened #ribbon-v{opacity:0;}
  .gift.opened #rays{opacity:1; transform:scale(1);}
  .gift.opened #glow{opacity:1;}

  #rays{opacity:0; transform:scale(.4);}
  #glow{opacity:0; transition:opacity .6s ease;}

  @keyframes tug{
    0%,100%{transform:translateY(0) rotate(0);}
    30%{transform:translateY(5px) rotate(-2deg);}
    65%{transform:translateY(-2px) rotate(1.5deg);}
  }
  .gift.tug #box{animation:tug .45s ease;}

  .gift-hint{font-family:'Marcellus',serif; font-size:11px; letter-spacing:.22em; text-transform:uppercase;
    color:var(--cream-dim); margin:26px 0 0; min-height:16px; transition:color .4s;}
  .gift-hint.warm{color:var(--gold-bright);}
  .pull-dots{display:flex; gap:9px; justify-content:center; margin-top:16px;}
  .pull-dots span{width:5px; height:5px; border-radius:50%; background:rgba(201,161,94,.22); transition:all .4s;}
  .pull-dots span.on{background:var(--gold-bright); box-shadow:0 0 9px var(--gold-bright);}

  /* itinerary */
  .section-head{margin:56px auto 0; max-width:560px;}
  .section-head .utility{display:block; margin-bottom:10px;}
  .section-head h3{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif; font-style:italic; font-weight:500;
    font-size:clamp(26px,5vw,38px); color:var(--gold-bright); margin:0;}

  .day-tabs{display:flex; gap:10px; justify-content:center; margin:26px auto 0; flex-wrap:wrap;}
  .day-tab{background:transparent; border:1px solid rgba(201,161,94,.3); color:var(--cream-dim);
    font-family:'Marcellus',serif; font-size:10px; letter-spacing:.2em; text-transform:uppercase;
    padding:12px 20px; cursor:pointer; transition:all .4s ease;}
  .day-tab:hover{border-color:var(--gold);}
  .day-tab.on{border-color:var(--gold); color:var(--gold-bright); background:rgba(201,161,94,.08);
    box-shadow:0 0 20px rgba(240,207,142,.12);}
  .day-tab small{display:block; font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif; font-size:14px;
    letter-spacing:.02em; text-transform:none; color:var(--cream-dim); margin-top:5px; font-style:italic;}

  .day-panel{max-width:560px; width:100%; margin:26px auto 0; text-align:left;}
  .day-panel[hidden]{display:none;}
  .day-lede{font-style:italic; font-size:19px; line-height:1.7; color:var(--cream-dim);
    text-align:center; margin:0 0 30px; padding:0 10px;}

  .timeline{position:relative; padding-left:28px;}
  .timeline::before{content:''; position:absolute; left:5px; top:8px; bottom:8px; width:1px;
    background:linear-gradient(180deg, transparent, var(--gold), transparent); opacity:.5;}
  .moment{position:relative; padding:0 0 30px;}
  .moment:last-child{padding-bottom:0;}
  .moment::before{content:''; position:absolute; left:-27px; top:7px; width:7px; height:7px;
    border-radius:50%; background:var(--gold-bright); box-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(240,207,142,.7);}
  .moment .t{font-family:'Marcellus',serif; font-size:10px; letter-spacing:.22em; color:var(--gold);
    text-transform:uppercase;}
  .moment .what{font-size:22px; line-height:1.35; color:var(--cream); margin:5px 0 0;}
  .moment .why{font-size:17px; line-height:1.65; color:var(--cream-dim); font-style:italic; margin:7px 0 0;}
  .moment .why b{font-style:normal; font-weight:500; color:var(--gold);}

  .notecards{display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:16px; max-width:560px;
    width:100%; margin:34px auto 0; text-align:left;}
  @media (max-width:560px){ .notecards{grid-template-columns:1fr;} }
  .notecard{border:1px solid var(--line); padding:26px 22px;
    background:linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(16,27,56,0.55), rgba(8,14,32,0.55));}
  .notecard h4{font-family:'Marcellus',serif; font-size:10px; letter-spacing:.24em; text-transform:uppercase;
    color:var(--gold); margin:0 0 16px; font-weight:400;}
  .notecard ul{list-style:none; margin:0; padding:0;}
  .notecard li{font-size:17px; line-height:1.6; color:var(--cream-dim); padding:0 0 12px 18px; position:relative;}
  .notecard li:last-child{padding-bottom:0;}
  .notecard li::before{content:'✦'; position:absolute; left:0; top:1px; color:var(--gold); font-size:9px;}
  .notecard li b{font-weight:500; color:var(--cream); font-family:'Marcellus',serif; font-size:11px;
    letter-spacing:.12em; text-transform:uppercase; display:block; margin-bottom:2px;}

  #confetti-canvas{position:fixed; inset:0; pointer-events:none; z-index:5;}

  footer.replay{margin-top:34px;}
  .replay-link{font-family:'Marcellus',serif; font-size:11px; letter-spacing:.15em; color:var(--cream-dim); text-decoration:none; border-bottom:1px solid transparent; cursor:pointer;}
  .replay-link:hover{color:var(--gold); border-color:var(--gold);}

  /* admin skip */
  #skipBtn{position:fixed; right:14px; bottom:14px; z-index:8; background:none; border:none;
    color:rgba(201,189,168,.28); font-family:'Marcellus',serif; font-size:10px; letter-spacing:.2em;
    text-transform:uppercase; cursor:pointer;}
  #skipBtn:hover{color:var(--gold);}
  #adminModal{position:fixed; inset:0; z-index:9; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
    background:rgba(5,3,2,.82); padding:20px;}
  .admin-box{background:#0a1122; border:1px solid var(--line); padding:30px 26px; max-width:320px; width:100%; text-align:center;}
  .admin-box p{margin:0 0 16px; font-family:'Marcellus',serif; font-size:11px; letter-spacing:.2em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--gold);}
  #adminInput{background:transparent; border:none; border-bottom:1px solid var(--gold); color:var(--gold-bright);
    font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif; font-size:20px; text-align:center; width:100%; padding:8px 0; outline:none;}
  .admin-error{color:var(--rose); font-family:'Marcellus',serif; font-size:10px; letter-spacing:.12em; margin:12px 0 0;}
  .admin-actions{display:flex; gap:10px; margin-top:20px;}
  .admin-actions button{flex:1; padding:11px 0; font-family:'Marcellus',serif; font-size:10px;
    letter-spacing:.18em; text-transform:uppercase; cursor:pointer; background:transparent;
    border:1px solid var(--line); color:var(--cream-dim);}
  .admin-actions #adminGo{border-color:var(--gold); color:var(--gold-bright);}
  [hidden]{display:none !important;}

  @media print{
    body{background:#fff !important; color:#101728 !important;}
    #embers, #confetti-canvas, #skipBtn, #adminModal, .btn, .flourish, footer.replay, #letter-scroll{display:none !important;}
    .stage{display:none !important;}
    #stage-9{display:block !important; min-height:0; padding:0;}
    #stage-9 .utility, #stage-9 .display{color:#101728 !important;}
    .card{box-shadow:none; border:1px solid #c9a15e; background:#fff !important;}
    .card::before{display:none;}
    .row .v, .note{color:#101728 !important;}
    .details-photo{border-color:#ddd;}
    .day-tabs{display:none !important;}
    .day-panel[hidden]{display:block !important;}
    .day-panel, .notecard{page-break-inside:avoid;}
    .section-head h3, .moment .what, .day-lede{color:#101728 !important;}
    .moment .why, .notecard li{color:#3c4763 !important;}
    .notecard{background:#fff !important; border-color:#c9a15e;}
    .timeline::before{background:#c9a15e; opacity:.4;}
  }

  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){
    *{animation-duration:0.01ms !important; animation-iteration-count:1 !important; transition-duration:0.01ms !important;}
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>

<div id="embers"></div>
<canvas id="confetti-canvas"></canvas>

<!-- STAGE 0: OPENING -->
<section class="stage active" id="stage-0">
  <svg class="flourish" viewBox="0 0 200 40" fill="none"><path d="M0 20 C50 0, 70 40, 100 20 C130 0, 150 40, 200 20" stroke="#c9a15e" stroke-width="1"/><circle cx="100" cy="20" r="3" fill="#f0cf8e"/></svg>
  <div class="monogram">N <span class="amp">&amp;</span> S</div>
  <div class="utility">an occasion, for you</div>
  <h1 class="display">Happy Birthday,<br>Stevanus</h1>
  <p class="sub">Before I hand you what I've been keeping, there is a small journey we have to make together. Are you ready?</p>
  <button class="btn" onclick="goTo(1)">Begin</button>
  <svg class="flourish flip" viewBox="0 0 200 40" fill="none"><path d="M0 20 C50 0, 70 40, 100 20 C130 0, 150 40, 200 20" stroke="#c9a15e" stroke-width="1"/><circle cx="100" cy="20" r="3" fill="#f0cf8e"/></svg>
</section>

<!-- STAGE 1: CANDLES -->
<section class="stage" id="stage-1">
  <div class="utility">the first</div>
  <h2 class="display step-title">Blow out the candles</h2>
  <p class="sub">Touch each flame to put it out. Make one wish before the last one goes dark.</p>
  <div class="candles" id="candles"></div>
  <div class="candle-hint" id="candle-hint">0 of 5 gone out</div>
</section>

<!-- STAGE 2: PUZZLE -->
<section class="stage" id="stage-2">
  <div class="utility">the second</div>
  <h2 class="display step-title">Piece it back together</h2>
  <p class="sub">Slide the pieces until the picture is whole again — you may recognise it.</p>
  <div id="puzzle-board"></div>
  <div id="puzzle-goal-label">tap a piece beside the empty space</div>
</section>

<!-- STAGE 3: RIDDLES -->
<section class="stage" id="stage-3">
  <div class="utility">the third</div>
  <h2 class="display step-title">Three questions</h2>
  <div class="riddle-box">
    <div class="riddle-q" id="riddle-q"></div>
    <input class="riddle-input" id="riddle-input" type="text" placeholder="your answer..." autocomplete="off">
    <div class="riddle-msg" id="riddle-msg"></div>
    <div class="riddle-progress" id="riddle-progress"></div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- STAGE 4: SEAL -->
<section class="stage" id="stage-4">
  <div class="utility">the last</div>
  <h2 class="display step-title">One seal remains</h2>
  <p class="sub">Break it, and everything I've been holding back is yours.</p>
  <div class="seal-wrap" id="seal-wrap" onclick="crackSeal()">
    <div class="seal">
      <svg viewBox="0 0 100 100"><path d="M50 20 C35 20 25 32 25 45 C25 65 50 82 50 82 C50 82 75 65 75 45 C75 32 65 20 50 20 Z" fill="none" stroke="#f0cf8e" stroke-width="2"/></svg>

<!-- STAGE 5: LETTER -->
<section class="stage" id="stage-5">
  <svg class="flourish" viewBox="0 0 200 40" fill="none"><path d="M0 20 C50 0, 70 40, 100 20 C130 0, 150 40, 200 20" stroke="#c9a15e" stroke-width="1"/><circle cx="100" cy="20" r="3" fill="#f0cf8e"/></svg>
  <div class="utility">and now, quietly</div>

      Happy birthday, my love.<br><br>
      Of all the days in the year, this is the one I most want to celebrate — because the world became a kinder place the moment you were in it. Thank you for being the reason I smile on ordinary days, and the place I come home to on the hard ones.<br><br>
      I hope this year carries you closer to everything you've been dreaming of. I'll be here the whole way, watching and cheering from the very front row.<br><br>
      Happy birthday. I love you, more than words are built to hold.

<section class="stage" id="stage-9">

  <div class="card">

    <div class="details-photos">
      <img class="details-photo" src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="">
      <img class="details-photo" src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="">
    </div>
  </div>

    <span class="utility">three days in Sài Gòn</span>
    <h3>How we'll spend them</h3>
  </div>

  <div class="day-tabs">
    <button class="day-tab on" data-day="1" onclick="showDay(1)">Day I<small>Fri, 18 Sept</small></button>
    <button class="day-tab" data-day="2" onclick="showDay(2)">Day II<small>Sat, 19 Sept</small></button>
    <button class="day-tab" data-day="3" onclick="showDay(3)">Day III<small>Sun, 20 Sept</small></button>
  </div>

  <div class="day-panel" id="day-1">
    <p class="day-lede">We land into someone else's evening. Nothing ambitious tonight — just the two of us, loose in a city that stays awake.</p>
    <div class="timeline">
      <div class="moment"><div class="t">16.40</div><p class="what">Landing at Tân Sơn Nhất</p><p class="why">Immigration and bags — out by half five, if the queue is kind.</p></div>
      <div class="moment"><div class="t">18.00</div><p class="what">Check in — KiN Hotel Thi Sách</p><p class="why">Grab from the airport, thirty to forty-five minutes, around <b>150–200k VND</b>.</p></div>
      <div class="moment"><div class="t">19.00</div><p class="what">Bùi Viện Walking Street</p><p class="why">Dinner and a first wander, close enough to walk. Street food is safe — I'll follow whichever stall the locals are queuing at.</p></div>
      <div class="moment"><div class="t">later</div><p class="what">Whatever we feel like</p><p class="why">No plan past this point. First nights are for being tired together.</p></div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="day-panel" id="day-2" hidden>
    <p class="day-lede">The full day. History in the morning, markets in the afternoon, and the whole city under us before the sun goes.</p>
    <div class="timeline">
      <div class="moment"><div class="t">08.00</div><p class="what">Independence Palace</p><p class="why">Around <b>40k VND</b>. It shuts at eleven for lunch, so we go early.</p></div>
      <div class="moment"><div class="t">09.30</div><p class="what">War Remnants Museum</p><p class="why">A short walk from the palace, <b>40k VND</b>. Heavy, and honest about it — I wanted you to know before we walk in, not after.</p></div>
      <div class="moment"><div class="t">11.30</div><p class="what">Lunch at Ola Hale</p><p class="why">Somewhere cool to sit down and put the morning behind us.</p></div>
      <div class="moment"><div class="t">13.00</div><p class="what">Bến Thành Market</p><p class="why">Things to bring home. Haggle — the first price is usually <b>two or three times</b> what it should be.</p></div>
      <div class="moment"><div class="t">15.00</div><p class="what">Oasis Café</p><p class="why">An hour out of the heat. Nothing to see, only to sit.</p></div>
      <div class="moment"><div class="t">17.00</div><p class="what">Landmark 81 · Saigon Skydeck</p><p class="why">Tickets bought online beforehand — cheaper, and no queue. Up before golden hour, around <b>17.45</b>.</p></div>
      <div class="moment"><div class="t">19.30</div><p class="what">A slow dinner</p><p class="why">Near the hotel. Feet up, no walking left in us.</p></div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="day-panel" id="day-3" hidden>
    <p class="day-lede">A soft last morning — old architecture, one final coffee, and home before midnight.</p>
    <div class="timeline">
      <div class="moment"><div class="t">07.30</div><p class="what">Breakfast, then checkout</p><p class="why">Bags stay with reception so we walk the last morning light.</p></div>
      <div class="moment"><div class="t">08.30</div><p class="what">Saigon Book Street</p><p class="why">On foot from the hotel, shaded the whole way.</p></div>
      <div class="moment"><div class="t">09.15</div><p class="what">Central Post Office</p><p class="why">Three minutes away. Colonial ironwork, and the best photo of you I'll take all trip.</p></div>
      <div class="moment"><div class="t">10.00</div><p class="what">The Café Apartment</p><p class="why">Last coffee, one floor at a time.</p></div>
      <div class="moment"><div class="t">11.30</div><p class="what">Towards the airport</p><p class="why">Thirty to forty-five minutes from District 1 — Grab ordered early, before the rush.</p></div>
      <div class="moment"><div class="t">15.50</div><p class="what">SGN → CGK</p><p class="why">Singapore Airlines, conf. <b>E4IYN4</b>. At the airport by <b>13.50</b>. Landing home at 22.40.</p></div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="notecards">
    <div class="notecard">
      <h4>Before we fly</h4>
      <ul>
        <li><b>Visa</b>None needed — Indonesians stay visa-free under 45 days.</li>
        <li><b>Cash</b>Change some VND. Cards work in malls and hotels; street stalls still run on cash.</li>
        <li><b>eSIM</b>Buy one before we leave. Viettel holds the steadiest signal.</li>
        <li><b>Grab</b>Installed on both our phones — cheaper and safer than flagging a taxi.</li>
        <li><b>Plugs</b>220V, type A and C. Same as home, no adaptor.</li>
        <li><b>Time</b>GMT+7. Same hour as Jakarta — no jet lag to lose.</li>
        <li><b>September</b>Rainy season, humid. A folding umbrella; the rain passes quickly.</li>
        <li><b>Emergency</b>Police 113 · Ambulance 115.</li>
      </ul>
    </div>
    <div class="notecard">
      <h4>Worth knowing</h4>
      <ul>
        <li><b>Crossing the road</b>Walk slowly and never stop. The motorbikes flow around you — running is what breaks it.</li>
        <li><b>A little Vietnamese</b>Xin chào — hello. Cảm ơn — thank you. Bao nhiêu? — how much?</li>
        <li><b>Water</b>Bottled or filtered only. Refill at the hotel; the heat drinks more than you think.</li>
        <li><b>Tipping</b>Not expected. 10–20k VND is kindly taken in nicer places.</li>
        <li><b>Watch for</b>Taxis without a meter, and change counted short. Always check the note before pocketing it.</li>
        <li><b>ATMs</b>Everywhere in District 1. Draw larger amounts at once to dodge the fees.</li>
      </ul>
    </div>
  </div>


  <button class="btn quiet" onclick="window.print()">Print the itinerary</button>
  <footer class="replay"><a class="replay-link" onclick="location.reload(); return false;">start again</a></footer>
</section>

<button id="skipBtn" onclick="openAdmin()">skip</button>
<div id="adminModal" hidden>
  <div class="admin-box">
    <p>Enter code</p>
    <input id="adminInput" type="password" autocomplete="off">
    <p class="admin-error" id="adminError" hidden>Wrong code, try again.</p>
    <div class="admin-actions">
      <button id="adminCancel" onclick="closeAdmin()">Cancel</button>
      <button id="adminGo" onclick="checkAdmin()">Go</button>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
/* ---------- ambient embers ---------- */
const emberField = document.getElementById('embers');
for(let i=0;i<26;i++){
  const e = document.createElement('div');
  e.className='ember';
  e.style.left = Math.random()*100+'vw';
  e.style.setProperty('--drift', (Math.random()*60-30)+'px');
  e.style.animationDuration = (6+Math.random()*8)+'s';
  e.style.animationDelay = (Math.random()*10)+'s';
  emberField.appendChild(e);
}

/* ---------- stage nav ---------- */
function goTo(n){
  document.querySelectorAll('.stage').forEach(s=>s.classList.remove('active'));
  document.getElementById('stage-'+n).classList.add('active');
  if(n===1) initCandles();
  if(n===2) initPuzzle();
  if(n===3) initRiddles();
  if(n===7) resetGift();
  if(n===5 || n===8) burstConfetti();
  window.scrollTo(0,0);
}

/* ---------- candles ---------- */
function initCandles(){
  const wrap = document.getElementById('candles');
  wrap.innerHTML='';
  let lit = 5;
  for(let i=0;i<5;i++){
    const c = document.createElement('div');
    c.className='candle';
    c.innerHTML = `<svg viewBox="0 0 34 110">
        <g class="flame"><ellipse cx="17" cy="14" rx="6" ry="12" fill="#f0cf8e"/><ellipse cx="17" cy="17" rx="3" ry="7" fill="#f7e3ad"/></g>
        <ellipse class="smoke" cx="17" cy="10" rx="4" ry="6" fill="#7e879e"/>
        <rect x="12" y="20" width="10" height="80" fill="#8fa2d8"/>
      </svg>`;
    c.onclick = ()=>{
      if(c.classList.contains('out')) return;
      c.classList.add('out');
      lit--;
      document.getElementById('candle-hint').textContent = (5-lit)+' of 5 gone out';
      if(lit===0){
        setTimeout(()=>{ document.getElementById('candle-hint').textContent='May the wish find its way to you ✦'; setTimeout(()=>goTo(2), 1400); }, 400);
      }
    };
    wrap.appendChild(c);
  }
}

/* ---------- puzzle (a real photo, sliced 3x3) ---------- */
const PUZZLE_IMG = "data:image/jpeg;base64,";
function initPuzzle(){
  const board = document.getElementById('puzzle-board');
  board.innerHTML='';
  const order = [0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8];
  let positions = shuffleSolvable(order.slice());
  render();

  function render(){
    board.innerHTML='';
    positions.forEach((val, idx)=>{
      const t = document.createElement('div');
      t.className='tile' + (val===8?' blank':'');
      if(val!==8){
        const col = val%3, row = Math.floor(val/3);
        t.style.backgroundImage = `url("${PUZZLE_IMG}")`;
        t.style.backgroundPosition = `${col*50}% ${row*50}%`;
        t.onclick = ()=>tryMove(idx);
      }
      board.appendChild(t);
    });
    if(positions.every((v,i)=>v===i)){
      document.getElementById('puzzle-goal-label').textContent='whole again ✦';
      setTimeout(()=>goTo(3), 900);
    }
  }
  function tryMove(idx){
    const blankIdx = positions.indexOf(8);
    const r1=Math.floor(idx/3), c1=idx%3, r2=Math.floor(blankIdx/3), c2=blankIdx%3;
    if(Math.abs(r1-r2)+Math.abs(c1-c2)===1){
      [positions[idx],positions[blankIdx]] = [positions[blankIdx],positions[idx]];
      render();
    }
  }
  function shuffleSolvable(arr){
    let p = arr.slice();
    do{
      for(let i=p.length-1;i>0;i--){ const j=Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1)); [p[i],p[j]]=[p[j],p[i]]; }
    } while(!isSolvable(p) || p.every((v,i)=>v===i));
    return p;
  }
  function isSolvable(p){
    let inv=0;
    const flat = p.filter(v=>v!==8);
    for(let i=0;i<flat.length;i++) for(let j=i+1;j<flat.length;j++) if(flat[i]>flat[j]) inv++;
    return inv%2===0;
  }
}

/* ---------- riddles ---------- */
const riddles = [
  {q:"I grow by one every year, and yet you only shine the brighter for it. What am I?", a:["age","years","year","umur","usia"]},
  {q:"The safest place that is not a place at all, and still you can always go there. What am I?", a:["home","your arms","arms","you","pelukan","rumah"]},
  {q:"I cannot be bought, and still I give it to you every single day. What am I?", a:["love","my love","cinta","sayang"]}
];
let riddleIdx = 0;
function initRiddles(){
  riddleIdx = 0;
  const prog = document.getElementById('riddle-progress');
  prog.innerHTML='';
  riddles.forEach(()=>{ const d=document.createElement('div'); d.className='dot'; prog.appendChild(d); });
  showRiddle();
  document.getElementById('riddle-input').onkeydown = (e)=>{ if(e.key==='Enter') checkRiddle(); };
}
function showRiddle(){
  document.getElementById('riddle-q').textContent = riddles[riddleIdx].q;
  document.getElementById('riddle-input').value='';
  document.getElementById('riddle-msg').textContent='';
  document.getElementById('riddle-input').focus();
}
function checkRiddle(){
  const val = document.getElementById('riddle-input').value.trim().toLowerCase();
  const ok = riddles[riddleIdx].a.some(a=>val.includes(a));
  if(ok){
    document.querySelectorAll('.dot')[riddleIdx].classList.add('done');
    riddleIdx++;
    if(riddleIdx>=riddles.length){
      document.getElementById('riddle-msg').textContent='perfect ✦';
      setTimeout(()=>goTo(4), 900);
    } else {
      setTimeout(showRiddle, 350);
    }
  } else {
    document.getElementById('riddle-msg').textContent='not quite — try once more';
  }
}

/* ---------- seal ---------- */
function crackSeal(){
  document.getElementById('seal-wrap').classList.add('cracked');
  setTimeout(()=>goTo(5), 700);
}

/* ---------- admin skip ---------- */
function openAdmin(){
  document.getElementById('adminModal').hidden = false;
  document.getElementById('adminError').hidden = true;
  const i = document.getElementById('adminInput');
  i.value=''; i.focus();
  i.onkeydown = (e)=>{ if(e.key==='Enter') checkAdmin(); };
}
function closeAdmin(){ document.getElementById('adminModal').hidden = true; }
function checkAdmin(){
  if(document.getElementById('adminInput').value === '123456'){
    closeAdmin(); goTo(8);
  } else {
    document.getElementById('adminError').hidden = false;
  }
}



/* ---------- gift box ---------- */
function resetGift(){
  pulls = 0;
  const g = document.getElementById('gift');
  g.classList.remove('opened','tug');
  g.dataset.pull = 0;
  document.querySelectorAll('#pullDots span').forEach(d=>d.classList.remove('on'));
  const h = document.getElementById('giftHint');
  h.textContent = 'tap the ribbon';
  h.classList.remove('warm');
}

let pulls = 0;
const pullLines = [
  'the first knot gives',
  'almost — one more',
  'oh…'
];
function pullRibbon(){
  const gift = document.getElementById('gift');
  const hint = document.getElementById('giftHint');
  if(gift.classList.contains('opened')) return;

  pulls++;
  gift.dataset.pull = pulls;
  gift.classList.add('tug');
  setTimeout(()=>gift.classList.remove('tug'), 460);

  const dots = document.querySelectorAll('#pullDots span');
  if(dots[pulls-1]) dots[pulls-1].classList.add('on');

  hint.textContent = pullLines[pulls-1] || '';
  hint.classList.add('warm');

  if(pulls >= 3){
    gift.classList.add('opened');
    setTimeout(()=>{ hint.textContent = 'it was never a thing at all'; }, 700);
    setTimeout(()=>goTo(8), 1900);
  }
}

/* ---------- itinerary days ---------- */
function showDay(n){
  [1,2,3].forEach(d=>{
    document.getElementById('day-'+d).hidden = (d!==n);
    document.querySelector('.day-tab[data-day="'+d+'"]').classList.toggle('on', d===n);
  });
}

/* ---------- confetti ---------- */
function burstConfetti(){
  const canvas = document.getElementById('confetti-canvas');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  canvas.width = window.innerWidth; canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
  const colors = ['#f0cf8e','#c9a15e','#8fa2d8','#f7e3ad'];
  let particles = Array.from({length:110}, ()=>({
    x: canvas.width/2 + (Math.random()-0.5)*80,
    y: canvas.height*0.25,
    vx:(Math.random()-0.5)*8,
    vy:Math.random()*-6-2,
    size:Math.random()*5+2,
    color:colors[Math.floor(Math.random()*colors.length)],
    rot:Math.random()*360,
    life:0
  }));
  function frame(){
    ctx.clearRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);
    let alive=false;
    particles.forEach(p=>{
      p.vy += 0.15; p.x+=p.vx; p.y+=p.vy; p.life++;
      if(p.life<160){ alive=true;
        ctx.save(); ctx.translate(p.x,p.y); ctx.rotate(p.rot*Math.PI/180);
        ctx.fillStyle=p.color; ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0,1-p.life/160);
        ctx.fillRect(-p.size/2,-p.size/2,p.size,p.size);
        ctx.restore();
      }
    });
    if(alive) requestAnimationFrame(frame);
    else ctx.clearRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);
  }
  frame();
}
window.addEventListener('resize', ()=>{
  const canvas = document.getElementById('confetti-canvas');
  canvas.width = window.innerWidth; canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
});
</script>
</body>
</html>
